roars: Fafnyr rears up - the air shimmers with heat!
Fafnyr's scales split with fire - the cave is burning!
Morvax raises a bony hand - the dead answer!
Morvax laughs, and the floor goes cold beneath you!

pathNodes.name: Bonelord

signature.name: Stormlash
signature.description: The sky cracks its whip twice.

signature.name: Supernova

signature.name: Throatseeker

pathNodes.name: Phantom Jester

signature.name: Thousand Cuts

pathNodes.name: The Unseen

signature.name: Vanishing Act
signature.description: Applause from an empty room.

pathNodes.name: Crusader of Dawn

signature.name: Dawnbreaker
signature.description: The first light lands like a verdict.

pathNodes.name: Seer

signature.name: Providence

pathNodes.name: Avatar of Light

pathNodes.name: Voice of Fate

pathNodes.name: Hawkeye

signature.name: Twin Arrows
signature.description: Two answers to one question.

pathNodes.name: Packlord

signature.name: Alpha's Call
signature.description: The pack answers before the echo.

pathNodes.name: Stormbow
pathNodes.blurb: You shoot where the world will be. +28% crit, +10% flee.

signature.name: Arrow of Ages
signature.description: Loosed once. Arrives always.

pathNodes.name: Wild Sovereign
pathNodes.blurb: The wilds crowned you. +40 carry, immune to poison and stun.

signature.name: Stampede
signature.description: Every hoof, claw and wing you ever spared.

pathNodes.name: High Judge
pathNodes.blurb: The bench is a battlement. +16% crit, +20% gold.

signature.name: Sentence
signature.description: Read aloud, carried out.

pathNodes.name: Bulwark of Faith

signature.name: Aegis Wall
signature.description: The shield speaks for the whole line.

pathNodes.name: Justice Incarnate

signature.name: Final Dawn
signature.description: The last case anyone tries.

pathNodes.name: The Undying Shield
pathNodes.blurb: +8 DEF, immune to stun and poison, fiercer when bloodied.

signature.name: Last Bastion
signature.description: Where you stand, the losing stops.

pathNodes.name: Herald of Rot
pathNodes.blurb: Decay sends invitations. Attacks poison far more often.

signature.name: Black Harvest
signature.description: The field reaps itself.

pathNodes.name: Gravelord
pathNodes.blurb: The dead pay rent. +4 DEF, venom-proof, kills refund 4 MP.

signature.name: Tomb Legion
signature.description: Your honor guard has been waiting.

pathNodes.name: Plague Incarnate
pathNodes.blurb: Epidemics cite you. Attacks fester; kills feed the mind.

signature.name: Extinction Bloom
signature.description: One flower. No survivors.

pathNodes.name: King in Bone
pathNodes.blurb: Death filed for retirement. +6 DEF, immune to poison and stun.

signature.name: Ossuary Throne
signature.description: Sit. Let the kingdom defend itself.

levels.name: Mossy Cellar
levels.description: Something gelatinous lurks beneath the tavern.

levels.name: Whispering Woods
levels.description: Goblins have been robbing travelers on the forest road.

levels.name: Barrow Crypt
levels.description: The dead of the old kingdom do not rest easy.

levels.name: Frosthowl Pass
levels.description: Wolves with eyes like embers stalk the mountain trail.

levels.name: Ruined Watchtower
levels.description: An orc warband has claimed the old garrison.

levels.name: Drowned Chapel
levels.description: Cold voices sing hymns in the flooded nave.

levels.name: Sunken Forge
levels.description: The dwarven guardians still obey their final order: none shall pass.

levels.name: Gloomdeep Caverns
levels.description: Miners fled when the bridge trolls stopped charging tolls and started charging people.

levels.name: Stormcrag Aerie
levels.description: Wyverns nest in the high crags, guarding the path to the summit.

levels.name: The Ashen Throne
levels.description: Fafnyr the Ashen waits atop the mountain. End this.

levels.name: The Sunless Stair
levels.description: Behind the dragon's hoard, a stairway descends into the dark.

levels.name: Hall of Echoes
levels.description: The dead of the deep kingdom whisper. Some of them still march.

levels.name: The Vaulted Hoard
levels.description: A treasury untouched for centuries. Some of the chests are hungry.

levels.name: Ember Warrens
levels.description: The tunnels glow warm. The imps that dug them think you look flammable.

levels.name: Throne of the Deathless
levels.description: Morvax has waited below since before the mountain had a name. End this. Again.

undermountain.name: The Undermountain
undermountain.sealed: The seal on the deep holds fast. The dragon above still reigns.

armor.about: PIX-185: armour turns aside a share of every hit instead of a flat amount, so it always helps and never makes anyone immune: a hit of `raw` against armour `a` lands raw*raw/(raw + weight*a). Both ways - the hero's swings against a monster's defense, a monster's against the hero's.

stunGuard.about: PIX-186: after a stun takes hold, a boss or an elite (named monsters too) halves the next for this many seconds - a one-turn stun is shrugged off - so Frost Nova can't hold them in place.

greymaw.name: Old Greymaw
greymaw.where: the south-east corner of the Whispering Forest
greymaw.notice: A grey wolf as big as a pony has taken three sheep from the forest farms, and a shepherd's boot with the shepherd still in it. The old ones call it Greymaw. It howls and the forest answers.
greymaw.seen: Old Greymaw lifts its head and howls!
greymaw.homecoming: The shepherds have hung Greymaw's tail over the well. The sheep sleep easy tonight.

drowned_knight.name: The Drowned Knight
drowned_knight.where: the drowned road at the south of the Sunken Marsh
drowned_knight.notice: A knight in rusted mail walks the drowned road at the bottom of the marsh. He was buried in the bog a hundred years ago and has not noticed. The hands of the bog come up where he points.
drowned_knight.seen: The Drowned Knight points, and the bog reaches for you!
drowned_knight.homecoming: The marsh-cutters are singing again. Someone has set a candle at the edge of the bog for the Drowned Knight.

cinderjaw.name: Cinderjaw
cinderjaw.where: the scorched hollow in the Ash Fields' south-east
cinderjaw.notice: Fafnyr's last brood-wyrm still nests on the high ash. It spits fire three ways at once and the caravans have stopped coming over the ridge.
cinderjaw.seen: Cinderjaw screams and the air fills with fire!
cinderjaw.homecoming: The caravans are back over the ridge. Hilda says the first one brought iron enough for a year.

mossback.name: Mossback
mossback.where: the walled glade at the heart of the Deepwood
mossback.notice: A troll so old that moss grows on its back sleeps in the walled glade of the Deepwood. When it wakes it throws the glade's stones at whoever woke it.
mossback.seen: Mossback wakes and tears a stone from the wall!
mossback.homecoming: The woodcutters are going back into the Deepwood. Fenn swears he heard the trees sigh.

gulp.name: Grandmother Gulp
gulp.where: the west bank of the Mirefen
gulp.notice: The mother of every mimic in the fen sits on the west bank looking like a treasure chest the size of a cart. She leaps. Bring a friend you don't like.
gulp.seen: Grandmother Gulp springs open - she has seen you!
gulp.homecoming: Odo has counted the treasure that came back from Grandmother Gulp twice. He is smiling, which nobody has seen before.

tidecaller.name: The Tidecaller
tidecaller.where: the grotto at the back of the sea cave
tidecaller.seen: The Tidecaller rises from its pool, and the cave fills with the sound of the sea!

seam_warden.name: The Seam Warden
seam_warden.where: the deep seam at the bottom of the Blackiron shafts
seam_warden.seen: The Seam Warden tears a lump of black iron from the wall!

hollow_captain.name: The Hollow Captain
hollow_captain.where: the captain's hall at the far end of the Greyhold cellars
hollow_captain.seen: The Hollow Captain rises from his chair. "None pass. Not till Oskar comes home."

rimefang.name: Rimefang
rimefang.where: the glass hall at the back of the ice cave
rimefang.seen: Rimefang uncoils from the ice, and the air turns to needles!

floorLift.about: PIX-170: the mountain comes last, so each floor's foes stand `lift` levels above their kind. A stat grows by the ratio of its curve (a + b*L + c*L*L) at the lifted level to its curve at the kind's own; XP grows gentler than the rest.

deepHunt.about: PIX-161: below Morvax's throne, generated depths without end. Depth d's foes stand at startLevel + d - 1, drawn from every family; every eliteEvery-th depth an elite guards the stair down. The hoard pays once per new deepest depth.
descriptions: The stair below the throne goes on down. Nobody built this far.
Things that fled the light came here to wait. They're done waiting.
The air is warm and old. Something below is breathing.
Bones of every kind, gnawed by every kind.
